title: RDW-to-albumin ratio adds negligible point-estimated digit-symbol prediction beyond flexible component measures in a second NHANES wave
abstract: In 1290 source and 1503 confirmation adults aged60+, adding RDW/albumin to a frozen flexible component model changed weighted confirmation MSE by -0.027475 score² (0.0167% relative improvement); conditional95%CI [-0.075936,0.016459] and source/target-refit95%CI [-0.528604,0.448004] cross zero. Incremental prediction was not established.
